# Albany Airport Taxi and Limo Service

> 24/7 taxi, car, and limo service to and from Albany International Airport
> (ALB), JFK, LaGuardia (LGA), Newark (EWR), Boston Logan, and New York City,
> serving the Capital Region of New York plus parts of Vermont and
> Massachusetts.

- Phone: (518) 327-0700
- Email: info@albanynyairporttaxi.com
- Hours: 24 hours a day, 7 days a week
- Service area: Albany, NY and surrounding counties (Albany, Rensselaer,
  Saratoga, Schenectady, Columbia, Greene, Dutchess, Ulster, Delaware,
  Otsego, Schoharie, Montgomery, Washington, Warren, Hamilton, Essex,
  Franklin, Clinton, Herkimer, Fulton counties in NY; Bennington and
  Rutland counties in VT; Berkshire county in MA)
- Fleet: taxi, sedan, SUV, and limo vehicles
